ecumenical: a. 一般的, 普遍的, 全基督教的, 泛基督教主義的

s concerned with promoting unity among churches or religions
s of worldwide scope or applicability

語感
偏正式，宗教用語
詞根詞綴
晚期拉丁 oecumenicus，源自希臘 oikoumene「有人居住的整個世界」
常見搭配
an ecumenical council；an ecumenical service

ecumenically (adverb)

ecumenism:
n. a movement promoting union between religions (especially between Christian churches)
n. (Christianity) the doctrine of the ecumenical movement that promotes cooperation and better understanding among different religious denominations: aimed at universal Christian unity
eczema: n. generic term for inflammatory conditions of the skin; particularly with vesiculation in the acute stages
<dl class="nd"><dt>語感</dt><dd>醫學用語</dd><dt>詞根詞綴</dt><dd>現代拉丁語，源自希臘 ekzema，由 ekzein「煮沸、爆發」而來，形容皮膚像沸騰般發疹</dd></dl>
